Title: Operations Analyst

Location: Remote

About the role
We are hiring a remote analyst to keep our monthly reporting on time.

Requirements

Contract: this is a contractor position (non-employment contract), paid in USD.
Salary: not disclosed.
How to apply: send your CV in English to jobs@example.com with the subject "Analyst".
